name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: .NET Developer | C# | SQL Server | REST API Design | CI/CD Pipelines | Microservices | Azure
summary: Back-End Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building and maintaining .NET web applications and backend services across finance and retail. Skilled in C#, SQL Server, REST API design, and CI/CD pipelines with a strong focus on system reliability, code quality, and secure deployment practices in cross-functional, remote teams.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases to production.
Enforced code quality practices (SonarQube, unit testing), reducing production defects by 30% and improving application maintainability.
Standardized CI/CD workflows across services, increasing deployment success rate above 95%.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting a global retail client, enabling scalable inventory processing and data-driven decision-making.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations.
Implemented asynchronous processing and integrations, improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Centralized business rules using JBoss BRMS, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Participated in system design, improving system resilience and reducing service downtime through fault-tolerant patterns.
Delivered backend services powering digital credit and mobile wallet platforms in production environments.
Eliminated operational bottlenecks by automating decision logic, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
